name: Dau me den
summary: Dầu mè đen xứ Quảng is black-sesame oil. The Da Nang Fatherland Front lists it at 3 stars, in thôn Lang Châu Nam, xã Duy Phước. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Thôn Lang Châu Nam, xã Duy Phước, on the Fatherland Front’s OCOP account.
howToEat: The account does not say how the oil is used. The method is Check on arrival.

where: Thôn Lang Châu Nam, xã Duy Phước. No street number. Check on arrival.
